origin.description: Simpson's rule on a rectangle. Odd panel counts are raised by one.
origin.usage: simpson2d(f, xa, xb, ya, yb, nx = 128, ny = 128, ...)

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Vectorized function of x and y.

origin.details: x^2 + y^2 on [-1, 1] x [-1, 1] with 8 by 8 panels
origin.value: Simpson's rule on a rectangle. Odd panel counts are raised by one.
origin.example: print(simpson2d(function(x, y) x^2 + y^2, -1, 1, -1, 1, nx=8, ny=8))
